status: Frozen production protocol after numerical screening; no training or test simulation available when locked
forcing: Fixed ABC curl-eigenfield, seed 7788; identical within every cloned triplet
marker_interpolation: Periodic cubic B-spline interpolation in the same RK4 stages, one-way tracers; adopted after the retained trilinear marker-grid failure
prediction_design: After screening, lock grid/time steps and new disjoint train/validation/test seed lists before production. Primary target: integral 0..1.5 of perturbation energy divided by its impulse-time value; paired per-field forecast error across both strengths. Compare conventional global present measurements, stronger current flow/local/marker summaries, history augmentation, and whole-run shuffled histories. Frozen models, independent held-out fields, group bootstrap and multiplicity controls for the two regimes.
scope: Periodic constant-density 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes. Transient, initially random flows; turbulence characterization is measured, not assumed. No walls, molecular interactions, thermal phases, particle feedback, laboratory data, or fully developed high-Reynolds turbulence claim.
primary_target: Integral of E_delta(t)/E_delta(0) from t=0 to1.5. One RMSE across both strengths per independent field, then average over fields.
primary_success: History-minus-strong-present RMSE interval upper bound below zero, also below mean matched shuffled-history-control RMSE. Two primary regimes: per-regime two-sided 97.5% intervals, Bonferroni protection. Also require improvement over the training-only mean outcome separately for each known impulse strength. This prior has no field observations or selected hyperparameters.
sample_size_basis: 24 train,8 validation,32 held-out independent fields per regime selected for a manageable resolved pilot from screening compute cost before fitting any forecast. The same independent seeds at both viscosities permit matched physical comparison; regimes are not additional independent seed replications.
recording_policy: Every current/history observation, energy/spreading/transfer trace, marker position, spectra and numerical checks retained losslessly; full-field initial/final SHA256 hashes. Complete fields regenerated from pinned source+seed+configuration; no all-field 3D snapshot archive.
numerical_failure_policy: Never train on or report a failed simulation as physically validated. Retain failures and numerical corrections. If a production numerical gate fails, refine that same seed before prediction evaluation and document the amended configuration; do not replace the seed or tune against prediction error.
secondary_scope: Response energy/spreading/marker/spectral statistics and refinement-prediction tables are descriptive/exploratory. Primary claim is only energy-response forecasting. Combined histories do not isolate a marker-only benefit.
null_uncertainty: Three control models trained/validated on whole-run derangements. In held-out evaluation, also average their RMSE over every nonidentity whole-field history donor. Bootstrap independent field nodes jointly in current and donor roles, excluding copies of the same original field. Fixed-permutation model bars are descriptive; the expected-shuffle comparison uses this dependence-aware U-statistic.
uncertainty_scope: Conditional on the frozen training/validation split and fitted models; the field bootstrap does not estimate variability from retraining on a different calibration ensemble.
features: See feature_names.json; strong present includes full velocity and full velocity-gradient tensor at the impulse center, global/spectral summaries, current geometry and initial energy-transfer rates. History appends the33 causal changes at three lags.
